rows.headline: SEBI warns investors against stock tips in private WhatsApp groups
rows.hook: Fraudsters target retail traders via WhatsApp groups
rows.summary: Market regulator SEBI has issued a public caution advising retail investors to stay away from unverified stock tips and trading recommendations shared through invitation-only WhatsApp groups. These closed networks are frequently used by fraudulent operators to manipulate share prices and dump holdings onto unsuspecting participants. Investors acting on these unauthorized tips risk heavy financial losses with no regulatory recourse. Retail participants should rely solely on registered intermediaries and verified research rather than social media groups.
rows.why_it_matters: WhatsApp stock tips risk heavy losses without regulatory safety nets

rows.headline: Traders ask Congress to reschedule November 1 Delhi rally
rows.hook: Festive sales threatened by political rally
rows.summary: The Chamber of Trade and Industry has requested Sonia Gandhi to postpone the INDIA bloc's November 1 rally at Ramlila Maidan. Traders fear that the expected influx of 10 lakh people and thousands of vehicles will paralyze traffic in 20 major Delhi markets. The body argues this disruption could jeopardize Rs 10,000 crore in business during the peak Diwali shopping period. They have proposed moving the event to Burari Maidan to avoid economic losses.
rows.whats_next: November 1, 2023
rows.why_it_matters: Delhi retail sales may drop if festive shopping access is blocked.
